<thought>We need to combine the two subnetworks into a single circuit description. The first subnet provides two resistors (2.222 Ω and 4.444 Ω) between nodes A‑N1 and N1‑X1. The second subnet provides six resistors (45 Ω, 5 Ω, 35 Ω, 15 Ω, 20 Ω, 30 Ω) connecting node B to three intermediate nodes (N_b1, N_b2, N_b3) and each of those to X1. To keep resistor identifiers unique we rename the two resistors from the first subnet as R7 and R8. The final topology therefore contains eight resistors with the connections listed below.</thought>
<final_answer>{"resistors": {"R1": 45.0, "R2": 5.0, "R3": 35.0, "R4": 15.0, "R5": 20.0, "R6": 30.0, "R7": 2.222, "R8": 4.444}, "connections": [["A","N1","R7"], ["N1","X1","R8"], ["B","N_b1","R1"], ["N_b1","X1","R2"], ["B","N_b2","R3"], ["N_b2","X1","R4"], ["B","N_b3","R5"], ["N_b3","X1","R6"]]}
